options.query: select ma_ttct, ten_ttct%l from dmttct where ma_ct = '@@voucherCode' and status = 1 order by stt

query.text: declare @strKey nvarchar(3000) set @strKey =' ma_ct = ''SM1''' exec ISWIFTStoreVoucherTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join sysunit b on a.unit_id = b.unit_id', 'b.ma_unit, b.ten_unit', '@@key', '', @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 0, @@admin, @@userId

finding.text: declare @strKey nvarchar(3000), @strDetailKey nvarchar(3000); set @strDetailKey = '' set @strKey = 'ngay_ct between ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct1, 112) + ''' and ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct2, 112) + ''' and ' + @strFinding + ' and ' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionGetUnitIDRightKeys(@@admin, @@userId, @ma_unit, 'a.unit_id') + @strDetailKey set @strKey = @strKey +' and ma_ct = ''SM1''' exec ISWIFTStoreVoucherTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join sysunit b on a.unit_id = b.unit_id', 'b.ma_unit', '@@key', @strKey, @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 0, @@admin, @@userId drop table #unitright

dir.script:
&VoucherJSLoading;
update smail set status = 7 from smail where id = @id update smailct set status = 7 from smailct where id = @id and r_mail = @r_mail
select '' as message
declare @script nvarchar(4000) exec ISWIFTStoreGetListFiles 'xfile', @id, '@@voucherCode', '', @script output
if @script is null set @script = ''
select @script as script
